fact: TechAfrica News reports the Government of Côte d'Ivoire launched EMY 101, an AI-powered chatbot on WhatsApp and Messenger giving citizens information on civil registration, taxation and land services, announced 15 March 2026.

We Are Tech Africa reports the Ivorian government launched EMY 101, an AI conversational assistant on WhatsApp, Messenger and toll-free number 101, giving information on civil status, taxation and ministerial services.

A youth ministry adviser said that at the early-2025 launch of the national apprenticeship placement programme the ministry presented a new digital platform that will be helped by AI to process CVs in recruiting young people and job seekers.
